lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: Good morning, Kracked Devs! It's Wednesday, October fourteenth. I'm Kopi, and today is all about agent skills.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: First up: Agent Skills is now an open standard. Anthropic built the format, just a folder with a SKILL dot MD file, and a growing list of agent products can load it.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: Installing them is one line now. Vercel's skills tool runs with npx skills add, pulls any skill straight from GitHub, and supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and seventy-five more agents.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: Supabase shipped two official skills. One covers the whole platform, from auth and storage to edge functions. The other is a Postgres best-practices guide for schemas, indexes and security.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: For explainers, there's Anatomy. Describe an idea in one line, and it invents a machine that works the same way, drawn as a live isometric figure. A message queue becomes a marble run.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: Finally, Cadu puts your self-hosted Hermes agent on iPhone. Scan a QR code to connect, then chat, manage files and follow what it's doing. It's in TestFlight beta right now.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: That's the diff for today. Every skill is on the wiki. Now go build something!
